test.title: A photograph that is important to you

document.cue: Describe a photograph that is important to you.

text: The photo I'd like to talk about is an old black-and-white picture of my grandparents on their wedding day in 1968. It's slightly faded and has a crease across one corner, but it's probably the most valuable thing in our family album.

They're standing in front of a small wooden house in a village near Shymkent. My grandfather is wearing a suit that's clearly too big for him, and my grandmother is holding a bunch of wild flowers instead of a proper bouquet. Neither of them is smiling, which was typical of photos at that time.

It was taken by the only man in the village who owned a camera, and apparently my grandfather paid him with a sack of potatoes. I only found out that story last year, when my grandmother saw me photographing the picture with my phone and started laughing.

It's important to me for two reasons. Firstly, my grandfather died before I was born, so this is one of the few ways I know what he looked like. Secondly, it reminds me how much has changed — today we take hundreds of photos a week, but back then a single picture was a real event.
I've made digital copies for all my cousins, but the original stays in a frame on my grandmother's shelf, where it belongs.

tips.en: A suit that's clearly too big for him is a lively detail instead of a general comment.
tips.kk: A suit that's clearly too big for him — жалпы «әдемі сурет» деудің орнына тірі дерек.
tips.ru: A suit that's clearly too big for him — живая деталь вместо общего «красивое фото».
tips.example: a suit that's clearly too big for him

tips.en: Hundreds of photos a week … a single picture was a real event contrasts past and present.
tips.kk: Hundreds of photos a week … a single picture was a real event — өткен мен бүгіннің қарама-қайшылығы.
tips.ru: Hundreds of photos a week … a single picture was a real event — контраст прошлого и настоящего.
tips.example: back then a single picture was a real event

note.en: What the photo shows and when — straight away, with a detail about its age.
note.kk: Суретте не бар және қашан — бірден, суреттің жасы туралы дерекпен.
note.ru: Что на фото и когда — сразу, с деталью о возрасте снимка.

note.en: A detailed description of the place, clothes and flowers lets the listener see the picture.
note.kk: Толық сипаттама: орын, киім, гүл — тыңдаушы суретті көреді.
note.ru: Подробное описание: место, одежда, цветы — слушатель видит снимок.

note.en: Who took it — a funny family story.
Why it matters — two reasons with Firstly and Secondly.
note.kk: Неге маңызды — Firstly / Secondly арқылы екі себеп.
note.ru: Почему важно — две причины через Firstly / Secondly.

note.en: The ending says where the photo is kept now.
